headline: Stylam Industries posts 62 percent one-year return against Nifty 50 decline
hook: Beating the benchmark by 73 percentage points
summary: Stylam Industries delivered a one-year return of 62.09 percent over the past year, outperforming the Nifty 50 index which recorded a negative return of 10.93 percent. The performance comparison highlights the divergent trajectory of the mid-cap stock relative to the broader benchmark market index. Indian retail investors tracking relative strength in equities may note this outperformance as an example of stock-specific momentum during a weak market phase.
why_it_matters: Stylam Industries outperformed the broader Nifty 50 index significantly.
winners_losers: Stylam shareholders gain / index trackers neutral
